record_title: Exact Haar moments remove sampling-dimension restrictions in sparse stochastic subspace descent
provenance: Scientific record deriving the exact second moment of the Haar projector compressed to a fixed active subspace and applying it to classical stochastic subspace descent for low-intrinsic-dimensional smooth objectives.
limitations: The result concerns independent Haar subspaces and exact projected gradients for a fixed orthonormal active subspace. It is an expectation guarantee and does not cover finite-difference error, stochastic gradient noise, non-Haar sketches, changing active subspaces, or the persistence-of-memory algorithm.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Exact rational verification of the Haar moment formula, source-regime rate comparison, limiting cases, and rank-one sharpness.
Executed exact-rational output for the sparse-SSD moment and rate checks.
